slides.title: Civilians caught in Badme border strikes
A truck hit by a drone
slides.body: On Nov 16 a drone struck a vehicle in Biara kebele near Badme, injuring at least four civilians, a local official told BBC Amharic.

slides.title: Returning for food
slides.body: The victims had fled to Sheraro and went back to fetch food, the official said. A woman with a serious eye injury was referred to hospital in Shire.
people displaced to Sheraro since the fighting began, per a Badme rural-area official (BBC Amharic)

slides.title: Residents flee again
slides.body: ACLED says a Nov 19 drone strike on Badme town forced residents to flee. No side has claimed either strike; not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow independent access.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
